data.content_ref: inline:The target asserts a 'custom 3-way merge costing at most 25 comparators' to achieve a 44-comparator network, but it fails to ground this claim in the attached dossier blocks by citing their block ids, as required by the problem context. It provides no structural proof or cited bounds for why a (4,4,5) merge costs <=25, relying instead on an analogy to Strassen matrix multiplication without verifying this specific sorting network merge cost.
